name: Sentinel
summary: +1 Str or Dex; Opportunity Attacks when nearby foes Disengage or hit others, and your hits with them stop foes.

benefits.name: Guardian
benefits.summary: Opportunity Attack a creature within 5 ft right after it Disengages or hits a target other than you.
benefits.text: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you takes the Disengage action or hits a target other than you with an attack, you can make an Opportunity Attack against that creature.

benefits.name: Halt
benefits.summary: A creature you hit with an Opportunity Attack has Speed 0 for the rest of the turn.
benefits.text: When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, its Speed becomes 0 for the rest of the current turn.
